'''Korvan''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[General/Legends|General]] of the [[Republic Army]] stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Quesh]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>

==Biography==
Korvan was a veteran of battles on [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]] and [[Velmor/Legends|Velmor]], and had years of experience defending resource rich planets. He was also an accomplished diplomat, able to balance the needs of the military with those of greedy corporations and their workers. He was the Republic's first choice to handle the [[Quesh war|crisis]] on [[Quesh]].<ref name="SWTORsb" />

Korvan's approach to the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire's]] invasion of Quesh was centered around the defense of the planet's [[Venenit queshaaga|venom]] mines and workers. This created tension amongst some of his men, specifically his strategist [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Treeg]] who believed that a direct assault would quickly end the invasion and was therefore a better option.<ref name="SWTORsb" />
